# Inkfin

> Inkfin is a free, private, read-only Markdown viewer for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). It renders GitHub Flavoured Markdown locally with search, themes, syntax highlighting, zoom and automatic refresh, with no accounts, analytics, telemetry or network requests.

A universal macOS build (macOS 14.2 or later, Apple silicon and Intel) is published as an explicitly unsigned test build: it is not signed or notarised, and macOS blocks its first launch until the user allows it.

Inkfin is a desktop application, not a web service. Current version 0.1.2; Windows installer 3.5 MB; price $0. Documents are opened and rendered on the user's own machine: remote images are blocked, raw HTML is not executed, and files are never modified.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://inkfin.maurya.ie/): Product overview, features, privacy details and FAQ
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/PriyansuMaurya/Inkfin): Source code, issues and documentation
- [Releases](https://github.com/PriyansuMaurya/Inkfin/releases): All versions and download files
- [v0.1.2 release notes](https://github.com/PriyansuMaurya/Inkfin/releases/tag/v0.1.2): Changes in the current version
- [Windows installer](https://github.com/PriyansuMaurya/Inkfin/releases/download/v0.1.2/Inkfin_0.1.2_x64-setup.exe): `Inkfin_0.1.2_x64-setup.exe` for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11
- [macOS disk image](https://github.com/PriyansuMaurya/Inkfin/releases/download/v0.1.2/Inkfin-0.1.2-universal-unsigned.dmg): `Inkfin-0.1.2-universal-unsigned.dmg`, unsigned and not notarised; Gatekeeper blocks the first launch until allowed in System Settings

## Platforms

- Windows: available. 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11; the installer includes the WebView2 bootstrapper. Version 0.1.2, installer 3.5 MB.
- macOS: unsigned test build. One universal disk image for macOS 14.2 or later on Apple silicon and Intel; signing, notarisation, stapling and a clean-Mac acceptance run are still outstanding.
- Not available: Linux, iOS, Android or a web version.

## Features

- Open `.md` and `.markdown` files via toolbar, drag-and-drop, or Windows Explorer
- GitHub Flavoured Markdown with syntax highlighting, tables and code blocks
- Light, dark and system themes; document and syntax colours update together
- Page zoom from 75% to 200%, preference stored locally
- Search within documents; the file auto-reloads on save while preserving scroll position and query

## Privacy

- No accounts or sign-in; preferences stay on the local machine
- Zero network requests: rendering, highlighting, search and refresh all run locally
- Read-only: Inkfin never writes back to your Markdown documents

## FAQ

- Supported systems: 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11; the installer includes the WebView2 bootstrapper. macOS 14.2 or later is targeted but not yet released
- macOS availability: the disk image is downloadable but unsigned and not notarised, so macOS blocks the first launch until it is allowed in System Settings. Signing, notarisation and clean-Mac verification have not happened
- Offline use: works fully without internet; remote images are intentionally blocked
- SmartScreen warning: the current installer is not code-signed; choose "More info" then "Run anyway" to run it
